TrackpadTyping — glide typing with your mouse or trackpad
=========================================================

1. Double-click TrackpadTyping.exe  (keep lexicon-en.txt in the same folder)
2. Press Ctrl+Alt+Space — the keyboard appears
3. Click into any text field first, then:
   - CLICK AND HOLD, sweep through a word's letters, RELEASE to type it
   - quick-click a letter to type just that letter (completions appear above)
   - click a suggestion chip, or press Left/Right arrows, to pick another guess
   - space bar (double-tap = period), ' , . ? ! keys, Shift key for capitals
   - Backspace key: right after a swiped word it deletes the whole word;
     hold it to delete more and more
   - top bar shows what you typed — click a word there, then swipe, to replace it
   - bottom row: your five most-used words; click to type one
4. Ctrl+Alt+Space again to put the keyboard away

Words you spell out by hand get learned automatically. Long-press a word chip
to make it forget one. Drag the panel by the little bar at its very top.

No install needed. Nothing leaves your computer.
